title: Everyone Thinks Tadej Pogačar Will Crush the Vuelta a España. He Says Not So Fast.
content:
The world No. 1 insists this Vuelta won't be a cakewalk and cautioned that he needs to leave Granada with something left in his legs for worlds, Europeans and Lombardia.
